project.name: Little Shop
project.description: A small shop. A few user goals. A complete story behind each one.

analysis.scope: Manually authored model of the executable examples/shop fixture. Not an automatic analysis of an external repository.
limitations: Customer-to-function interactions are inferred: the fixture has no UI or HTTP server.
Stock and orders are in memory. Payment uses a stub, not an external gateway.
Concurrency, idempotency, durable compensation, and persistence failures are outside the fixture.
Diagrams are static source interpretations, not runtime traces.
